user.title: Connect to the Furbo Treat Bridge
user.description:
Install and start the Furbo Treat Bridge add-on first. Leave the host and port as they are unless you run the bridge somewhere else. The API token is the one in the add-on's configuration, or the one it printed in its log.

{error}

code.title: Enter the code Furbo emailed you
code.description: Furbo sent a verification code to the email address in the add-on's configuration. You only need to do this once; the bridge remembers it.

data.send_new_code: Email me a new code instead

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to the Furbo Treat Bridge
reauth_confirm.description:
The bridge refused the API token. Enter the token from the add-on's configuration or log.

{error}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge. Is the Furbo Treat Bridge add-on running?
error.invalid_auth: The bridge refused this API token.
error.invalid_code: Furbo did not accept that code. Check it, or ask for a new one.
error.code_expired: That sign-in timed out. Tick the box to get a new code.
error.code_resent: A new code is on its way to your email.
error.signing_in: The bridge is still signing in to Furbo. Try again in a few seconds.
error.furbo_login_failed: The bridge could not sign in to Furbo. Check the email and password in the add-on's configuration, then restart the add-on.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the add-on's log.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.

toss_treat.name: Toss treat
toss_treat.description: Tosses one or more treats from a Furbo camera.

device_id.description: The Furbo camera to toss from.

count.name: Count
